📱 Device Compatibility & iPad Guide

This application is engineered as a standalone, zero-dependency offline web portal built to run smoothly on Apple iPad, iPhone, Android, and Windows PCs.

1. Apple iPad & iPhone (Safari):

  • Open the file in Safari.
  • Tap the Share button (box with an arrow pointing upward).
  • Select "Add to Home Screen".
  • The app launches in full-screen standalone mode without URL bars.

2. Android Tablets & Phones (Chrome):

  • Open the file in Google Chrome.
  • Tap the top-right menu (three dots) and tap "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".

3. Direct PDF Printing:

  • Use the "Blank Exam (PDF)" button on any chapter card to print or save a clean blank exam paper with ruled writing lines and blank comparison tables.
  • Use the "Answer Key (PDF)" button to print the model answer key with complete rationales.
